spec.alternative_hypothesis: The lag-1 TYVIX log change has a positive coefficient in the daily TYVIX→VIX partial lead-lag regression (rates volatility up predicts equity volatility up the next day), with partial R-squared at least 0.005 and a positive holdout out-of-sample incremental R-squared.
spec.benchmark: Own-history baseline: next-day VIX log change predicted from its own lagged log change and the contemporaneous SPX log return, without lag-1 TYVIX
cost_assumptions: Volatility indices are not tradable; VIX exposure requires VIX futures, and futures roll costs cannot be measured from free data: Yahoo VX=F returns no data (verified 2026-11-18) and no other reliable free VIX futures series was found
The cost gate is therefore informational, not a verdict criterion; the holdout out-of-sample incremental R-squared carries the economic weight
The reported gross sign-rule edge applies no costs at all and is an upper bound on any tradable edge
spec.cost_model: Informational only: volatility indices are not tradable; VIX exposure requires VIX futures and roll costs cannot be measured from free data (no reliable free VIX futures series — Yahoo VX=F returns no data). The trial reports the gross sign-rule edge on holdout out-of-sample forecasts (no costs applied) as an informational assessment, not a verdict criterion; the out-of-sample incremental R-squared criterion carries the economic weight.
exclusions: Bars outside the TYVIX coverage window (2003-01-02 to 2020-05-15) are out of sample.
Incomplete synchronized rows are excluded and counted.
FRED '.' missing values and Yahoo null closes are excluded at fetch time and counted.
The reverse placebo (VIX→TYVIX), the rolling-percentile descriptive, the sub-period stability split and the z-scored robustness are descriptive only and are not in the test family.
known_confounders: TYVIX measures expected volatility of 10-year Treasury futures prices, not yields; MOVE measures yield volatility. Both are rates implied volatility, but the substitution is approximate.
TYVIX was discontinued in May 2020; the sample ends 2020-05-15 and excludes the post-2020 rate-hiking cycle.
FRED publication lag is not modelled; available_at equals the close, so the lag-1 design assumes the previous day's close is usable at the next day's close.
The SPX factor is contemporaneous with the target; it controls the common equity-market driver but cannot absorb rate-driven common shocks that move both vol indices.
Volatility indices are mean-reverting; log changes are used, but residual autocorrelation is handled with HAC standard errors only.
The weekly test resamples the daily synchronized panel; weekly rows are not independent of the daily rows.
spec.mechanism: Rates volatility repricing (rate-expectation and term-premium shocks) transmits to equity volatility with a lag: rate moves reprice equity discount rates and risk appetite, and the rates market — larger and more policy-sensitive — reprices first. Thesis 001 H2: a large standardized move in one volatility market may precede a move in another.
spec.missing_data_policy: No forward filling; drop incomplete synchronized rows and report the dropped count. FRED '.' missing values and Yahoo null closes are excluded at fetch time and counted.
model_definition: Partial lead-lag OLS with HAC standard errors (daily TYVIX→VIX, daily TYVIX→VXN, weekly TYVIX→VIX)
Purged walk-forward out-of-sample evaluation of the daily primary model (baseline: own history plus SPX factor; augmented: plus lag-1 TYVIX)
Naive lead-lag scan (lags 0-5, raw Pearson correlations) as a descriptive upper bound (not in the test family)
spec.multiple_testing_family: Rates-volatility transmission to equity volatility (3 tests: a daily TYVIX→VIX, b daily TYVIX→VXN, c weekly TYVIX→VIX)
spec.null_hypothesis: Lag-1 TYVIX log changes have no incremental predictive value for next-day VIX log changes beyond VIX's own history and the SPX common-factor control, after dependence controls.
spec.primary_metric: Partial R-squared of lag-1 TYVIX log change in the daily TYVIX→VIX partial lead-lag regression
rejection_criteria: Holm-adjusted primary p-value at or above 0.05
Holdout out-of-sample incremental R-squared at or below 0
spec.research_question: Does the lag-1 log change in rates implied volatility (TYVIX, via FRED VXTYN) predict the next-day VIX log change beyond VIX's own history and the contemporaneous SPX common-factor control?
spec.target_definition: Next-day close-to-close VIX log change (daily primary and weekly robustness); next-day VXN log change (daily secondary)
spec.title: Rates volatility leads equity volatility
